systems.tiers: a training module for primary school teachers

note: Educmaster is named only as one module (with Word, Excel, PowerPoint and E-services) of a 20-day computer training for primary teachers that began on 1 July 2026 in 46 centres across Alibori, Atacora, Borgou, Donga, Collines and Zou, run by MAFLYT Sarl with the primary ministry's support, a second phase for the south due on 5 August 2026; the document does not say what Educmaster does, so no class and no fact.
